location: Bruxelles-Midi / Brussel-Zuid, Avenue Fonsny access porch

source.publisher: Inventaire du patrimoine architectural, Région de Bruxelles-Capitale
source.title: Gare du Midi et bâtiments annexes
facts_used: The Avenue Fonsny station access is a vast porch supported by polygonal columns.
The porch has a large concrete canopy opened with glass blocks.
Its middle register is pierced by three long bays with concrete cross framing filled with glass blocks.

placement.basis: existing authored readable Fonsny entrance geometry retained in production

runtime_scope.geometry: two shallow bay dividers plus one shallow cross rail on the existing glazing envelope; existing entrance columns retain their geometry
runtime_scope.materials: reuse shipped #323 architectural concrete and glass-block family

authored_not_measured: equal subdivision of the existing authored glazing span
recognition_hypothesis: At normal player distance, the entrance should read as the documented three-bay concrete/glass-block Fonsny porch rather than a single generic glazing plane.
licensing: No source photograph, logo, font or third-party texture is distributed; runtime geometry is original procedural presentation over existing project geometry.
